# lucid-yolo

> Independent, from-scratch PyTorch Lightning implementation of the real-time detection, instance-segmentation, oriented-detection, and keypoint-detection methods described in the YOLO26 paper (arXiv:2606.03748)

Every page below links to its markdown copy (`<page>/index.md`), with includes resolved and links absolute. `llms-full.txt` holds the guide, method, results and model-card pages in full. Source: https://github.com/Borda/lucid-YOLO


## Home

- [Overview](https://borda.github.io/lucid-YOLO/index.md): lucid-yolo is an independent, from-scratch PyTorch Lightning implementation of the real-time detection, instance segmentation, and oriented detection methods…
- [Method / How the detector works](https://borda.github.io/lucid-YOLO/method/how-it-works/index.md): One pass through the network turns an image into a fixed list of boxes. This page follows that pass in five stages and says which source file owns each one.…
- [Method / NMS versus NMS-free](https://borda.github.io/lucid-YOLO/method/nms-vs-nms-free/index.md): Non-maximum suppression (NMS) is the cleanup step most detectors run after the network: a dense head proposes many overlapping boxes per object, and NMS keeps…
- [Run it / Launching a training run](https://borda.github.io/lucid-YOLO/TRAINING/index.md): Four tiers, one command. lucid-yolo fit --config .yaml resolves the name against the configs packaged inside the wheel, so a run needs no checkout …
- [Run it / Provisioning the datasets](https://borda.github.io/lucid-YOLO/DATASETS/index.md): Datasets are never committed to this repository and never downloaded by test code (AGENTS.md sec. 3). Every unit gate runs offline against synthetic fixtures…
- [Clean-room / Provenance](https://borda.github.io/lucid-YOLO/PROVENANCE/index.md): Every design decision in this repository cites its public source. This file is the clean-room evidence record: sources are logged here on first use, and every…
- [Clean-room / Assumptions](https://borda.github.io/lucid-YOLO/ASSUMPTIONS/index.md): Anywhere the papers underdetermine the implementation, the chosen assumption, its public source, and its validation plan are recorded here before the…

## Models

- [Model cards / Detection](https://borda.github.io/lucid-YOLO/model_cards/detection/index.md): Finds the objects of 80 everyday categories in an image and returns one box, class and score per object, with no NMS step after the network.
- [Model cards / Instance segmentation](https://borda.github.io/lucid-YOLO/model_cards/segmentation/index.md): Finds each object and also marks which pixels belong to it: a box, a class, a score and a mask per object.
- [Model cards / Oriented detection](https://borda.github.io/lucid-YOLO/model_cards/obb/index.md): Finds objects in aerial imagery and returns a rotated box per object — centre, size and heading — instead of an axis-aligned one.
- [Model cards / Keypoints](https://borda.github.io/lucid-YOLO/model_cards/keypoints/index.md): Finds each person and the location of each of their joints: a box, a score and K points per object — here COCO's 17 human-pose points.
- [Notebooks / Development gates](https://borda.github.io/lucid-YOLO/notebooks/development_gates/)
- [Notebooks / Detection on COCO 2017](https://borda.github.io/lucid-YOLO/notebooks/demo_detect/)
- [Notebooks / Instance segmentation on COCO 2017](https://borda.github.io/lucid-YOLO/notebooks/demo_segment/)
- [Notebooks / Oriented detection on DOTA tiles](https://borda.github.io/lucid-YOLO/notebooks/demo_obb/)
- [Notebooks / Keypoints on COCO person_keypoints](https://borda.github.io/lucid-YOLO/notebooks/demo_keypoints/)

## API

- [Models](https://borda.github.io/lucid-YOLO/api/models/index.md): The four task models and the builders that construct them from a variant name. Each builder takes the n/s/m/l/x variant and a class count and returns a ready…
- [Data](https://borda.github.io/lucid-YOLO/api/data/index.md): The target container every task shares, the datasets that read COCO, YOLO-format and DOTA annotations into it, and the augmentation transforms that move…
- [Training](https://borda.github.io/lucid-YOLO/api/training/index.md): The Lightning pieces a training run is assembled from: the module that owns the model, loss and optimizer, the data module that builds the loaders, and the…
- [Inference](https://borda.github.io/lucid-YOLO/api/inference/index.md): Turning a trained model's raw outputs into detections: one-call prediction for a single image per task, and the decoders behind it, NMS-free top-k beside the…
